body.x: Various SMEs took an active role in the world’s biggest consumer electronics show ‘CES 2013 held in LAS VEGAS from Jan 8 to 11.

Daegu TP mobile convergence center supported Mobile convergence, cutting-edge technologies, enhancing business of 9 Mobile, IT companies and had obtained about $29,520,000 of benefits with 240,000 contracts at CES 2013.

Tech Zone ( Smart mobile, Display, Home network information appliance) received favorable feedback from global buyer. Especially, Tech Zone differentiated with booths for Hongkong and China at Venetian Hall and attracted many overseas buyers.

MAP TECH, which produces wireless charger for Tilt Smartphone, attracted attention from participants. US Energizer made contract with MAP TECH worth $75,000 and a supply contract with Global cellular phone producing company is procedding worth $5 million annually.

“We have participated In the world’s largest consumer electronics show , CES 2013 for the first time. Especially we have had meetings and consultation opportunity with overseas buyers so it is expected to expand target markets to overseas” Go, Ho-sung, president of MAP TECH said.

Also ‘RADIOGEARS’ which unveiled IPTV STB, has made $160,000 contract with 3 agency contracts as well. Moreover, “LCD display of Micro display, Digital Signage program ‘Q-sign’ for NDS solution, portable DJing device of JD sound, ITHEALTH’s shipping black box system called ‘Pack Story’ and urine&feces sensor, IScommunication’s electronic bulletin board and Black box for Digital Zone are expected to market North America near future.“ Daegu TP official said.

“By implementing the management of Tech Zone, special page for CES, press releases and marketing supports, we could have been advertising our products very well. Also we are planning to search small business companies with its technologies at high level.”Min Yong-ki, the manager of Mobile convergence center said.
